correctness.rationale: Verified against Bogachev–Rozikov primary equations (2.35)-(2.41), viewed rendered pages 18 and 58: set b=theta(theta+q-2)/(q-1), b_c=((k+1)/(k-1))^2, roots x_±=rho+(k-1)(b-b_c)/2 ±sqrt(k(b-b_c)+(k-1)^2(b-b_c)^2/4). On folds log a(x)=k log((k-1)x-1)-k log k-(k+1)log x. At rho=(k+1)/(k-1), Lprime=0, Ldoubleprime=-(k-1)^2/[k(k+1)] and Ltripleprime=2(k-1)^3(2k+1)/[k^2(k+1)^2]. The symmetric root difference cancels order sqrt epsilon and yields (k-1)^4/(3 sqrt k (k+1)^2) epsilon^(3/2), and bprime(theta_c)=(2theta_c+q-2)/(q-1). Dividing by log theta_c yields stated C>0 for all k,q>=2. Independent symbolic differentiation and numerical k,q examples corroborated; remainder O(delta^2) is valid (weaker than next order), q=2 halves use source antisymmetry. Not a statement about other multi-colour Gibbs phases.
